movie_title: Are smartphones killing cameras? 6 Minute English
introduction:
Improve your English vocabulary and speaking with 6 Minute English!
Everybody has a smartphone these

vocabulary.definition: no longer in use or no longer useful
vocabulary.example: Traditional cameras have become obsolete with the rise of smartphone photography.
Many people now opt for using smartphones as their primary camera.

vocabulary.definition: feeling upset or annoyed due to an inability to achieve something
vocabulary.example: Photography enthusiasts may feel frustrated with the limitations of smartphone cameras.

vocabulary.definition: a step of a ladder; a level in a hierarchy or system
vocabulary.example: Aspiring photographers aim to climb the rungs of skill development.

vocabulary.definition: easy to use or suitable for one's purpose; handy
vocabulary.example: Smartphone cameras are convenient for quick snapshots on the go.

vocabulary.definition: complex or intricate in design or function; refined
vocabulary.example: Modern smartphones come with sophisticated camera features like portrait mode and AI enhancements.
